**PhD candidate** in economics, with expertise in *economic impacts of drought analysis and in drought resilience assessment in Sub-Saharan African countries, particularly Madagascar*. Enrolled at the Doctoral School of Social Sciences and Humanities (EDSHS) at the **University of Antananarivo**. Member of the Center for Economic Studies and Research for Development ([CERED](https://ue-madagascar.org/teams/691)) and the International Joint Unit for Sustainability and Resilience ([UMI SOURCE](https://www.umi-source.uvsq.fr/)). Experiences shaped by the start of researcher career, administration, youth leadership, training and education.

## Key skills

- **Research** : Kaldor’s magic square analysis, Low Income Sub-saharan Africa Countries, press analysis, climate change scenarios, night light data analysis, national data analysis.

- **Tools** : R, Github, Overleaf, Excel, Libre Office/Word, Canva, PDF tools

- **Administration** : Assistante administrative [Projet BETSAKA](https://betsaka.hypotheses.org/) (2024-2027), local manager of Grain of Wheat International children club in Ambohitrimanjaka, Antananarivo Madagascar branch (2017-2023)

- **Non-Formal Education and Training**: [Safe.Educ](https://www.facebook.com/SafeEducMadagascar)

- **Leadership** : Maxwell’s leadership, Kingdom leadership, Positive Leadership, Team leadership, Youth and Children leadership
